drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 85-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.69, creatinine 0.78, hemoglobin 13.5, lactate 1.5, platelets 246, sodium 140, wbc 13.6; vitals dbp 65-66, heart_rate 88-102, map 84-86, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 18-21, sbp 120-126, spo2 96-97, temp 37.4-38.6
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Blood cultures x2; Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.82, hemoglobin 13.5, platelets 251, sodium 140, wbc 11.1; vitals dbp 65-71, heart_rate 82-86, map 83-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 119-126, spo2 96-97, temp 37.3-37.5
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 85-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
